deck: Nifty closed at 25,791 (▲ 1.74%) and Sensex at 83,982 (▲ 1.88%). Over the last five sessions Nifty is up 1.6%. Brent crude is near $88 a barrel and the rupee at 92.22 to the dollar.
story: Of the 80 large stocks this page tracks, 60 rose and 18 fell. DABUR led the gainers (+6.97%), while TATASTEEL fell the most (-2.45%). Bank Nifty ended ▲ 1.70%.
Across markets: Brent crude near $88 a barrel (-3.8% on the week), the rupee at 92.22 per dollar (stronger on the week), gold near $3,554 an ounce.

In the headlines: “Sensex Gains 1,323 Points, Nifty 50 Rises 1.52% as Banking and IT Stocks Support Markets” (Dalal Street Investment Journal). “Iran Reports Fresh Tanker Explosions as Hormuz Attacks Intensify” (Crude Oil Prices Today | OilPrice.com).
One session says little about the long run. Oil, the Iran war and foreign flows remain the big swing factors.

drivers.p: Brent is down 3.8% in a week. India imports most of its crude, so cheaper oil eases inflation, supports the rupee and helps oil users.
The rupee is at 92.22 per dollar, stronger than a week ago. A firmer rupee eases import costs and tends to steady foreign investors.
